summary: Frontend-only testing of Iteration 8: Toolkit Home + SafeSeed Verify/Scan tabs. Executed full end-to-end flows via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All requested critical flows PASS: routing (/, /redactorium, /safeseed) works; ToolkitNav pills (Home/Redactorium/SafeSeed) show correct active state (prefix match verified via aria-selected); SafeSeed mode toggle switches between Generate/Verify/Scan panels while CatalogInspector remains visible on all tabs. Verify strict happy path — generated a preset-crm-contacts fixture (seed=42, rows=10), downloaded CSV + record.json, round-tripped via verify-csv-upload and verify-record-upload → outcome 'PASS · strict-whole-file' with matching SHA-256. Verify tamper path — mutated a byte in the CSV → outcome 'FAIL · strict-whole-file' with hashMatch=false. Verify column-scoped — added 'notes' column, toggled verify-scoped-toggle → outcome 'PASS · column-scoped' and 'notes' surfaced as added/unattested (not failed). Scan clean CSV (2 rows of catalog-safe email/phone/ssn) → 3 attested columns @ 100%, 0 candidate PII, no flagged-values section. Scan dirty CSV — real.person@gmail.com and 123-45-6789 correctly appear in scan-flagged-values under email and ssn columns respectively (row 3), and 415-555-0199 was also flagged under phone. Upload buttons for verify/scan are wired to hidden file inputs and open a picker without error. Zero console errors captured. Regression: /redactorium still loads cleanly with masthead and sample-data controls. Mobile 390 — Toolkit Home renders stacked cards; Verify and Scan panels have no horizontal overflow.

issues: Horizontal overflow: document scrollWidth=454px vs viewport=390px (~64px overflow). Verify and Scan tabs at same viewport have no overflow. Likely from PresetPicker or SchemaEditor cell widths — pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration but flagged because the task asked 'no horizontal overflow on any /safeseed tab'.

action_items: Optional: investigate 64px horizontal overflow on /safeseed Generate tab at 390px (schema editor / preset picker row widths). New Verify/Scan panels are clean.
critical_code_review_comments: safeVerify.js parseCsvStrict: uses Papa.parse with header:false and filters empty single-cell rows — correctly handles trailing newlines. Good.
verifyFixture: strict mode requires hashMatch AND no added/missing cols AND zero range failures — matches spec. Scoped mode intentionally ignores hash and added cols — matches spec.
ScanPanel toast wording good; SCAN_THRESHOLD=0.6 confirmed via dirty-CSV test where 67% match rate still attested each column.
ToolkitNav uses pathname==='/' for Home active detection and startsWith for others — correct prefix match, verified on all three routes.

Minor: In VerifyPanel and ScanPanel, the upload button is a sibling of the hidden <input type=file>. Both file inputs on /safeseed verify tab share `accept='.csv,.txt'` and `.json` — the test used broad selectors and worked, but data-testid on the hidden inputs themselves would make future automation more robust.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Ephemeral fixture generated in-browser (crm-contacts, seed=42, rows=10) used only for round-trip Verify testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 8 acceptance criteria pass. If retesting, drive Verify via file-upload path (verify-csv-upload + verify-record-upload) to avoid CRLF/LF paste pitfalls — that is what worked here; CSV was written with CRLF by PapaParse.unparse on this platform. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Overflow on Generate tab @ 390px is cosmetic/pre-existing and outside the scope of the Verify/Scan additions.
